extracted.intended_audience: independent filmmakers, episodic storytellers, and artists seeking Sundance Institute labs, grants, fellowships, and community resources
extracted.subtask_description: Information and expectations for applicants and participants in Sundance Institute labs, fellowships, grants, intensives, and community programs, including program aims and code of conduct. Useful for artists preparing submissions or participation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commitment to champion unique work by individual storytellers
rubrics_metrics.description: At the Institute’s core is a commitment to champion the creation of unique work by individual storytellers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Programs consist of labs, grants, intensives, mentorships with accomplished professionals, and ongoing support to advance development, production, and completion of independent work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application pathways: open applications and by invitation
rubrics_metrics.description: Programs are offered through open applications and by invitation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Artists are encouraged from around the world to apply; view open and upcoming applications on the deadlines page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support across the creative journey
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide dynamic support at every step of the creative journey for individuals with distinct voices in film and episodic storytelling.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Support includes labs, grants, intensives, sessions, and ongoing resources to nurture projects and sustain careers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Artist Accelerator — funding, networks, professional growth
rubrics_metrics.description: The Artist Accelerator Program offers opportunities for artists to access funding to advance their projects, build their networks, and grow professionally.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program purpose is to advance projects and artist career development through funding and networking opportunities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Catalyst — facilitating financing partnerships
rubrics_metrics.description: Catalyst introduces prospective financiers to a slate of top-notch, Sundance Institute–supported documentary and fiction projects seeking financing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Aims to build a culture of partnership between independent investors and filmmakers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Documentary Film Program (DFP) — year‑round support for nonfiction filmmakers
rubrics_metrics.description: DFP provides year-round support to nonfiction filmmakers worldwide in the production of cinematic documentaries on contemporary themes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focus is on supporting production of cinematic, thematically contemporary documentaries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Episodic Program — tools and training for series and pilots
rubrics_metrics.description: The Episodic Program provides artists with the tools and training to develop their original series and pilot script.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasis on development of original episodic storytelling and pilot scripts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Feature Film Program — rigorous creative process and original storytelling
rubrics_metrics.description: The Feature Film Program provides year-round support to the next generation of filmmakers and encourages a rigorous creative process with a focus on original and deeply resonant storytelling.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Support targets filmmakers developing original feature-length work with emotional/resonant impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ignite — support for new voices aged 18–25
rubrics_metrics.description: Ignite identifies and supports new voices and talent from the next generation of filmmakers ages 18 to 25 and fosters fresh audiences for independent storytelling.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program targets early-career filmmakers in the specified age range and audience development.

rubrics_metrics.name: Indigenous Program — tailored support for Native and Indigenous storytellers
rubrics_metrics.description: The program is designed in response to the specific needs of Native and Indigenous storytellers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sundance’s commitment to supporting Native American artists is woven throughout the institute’s history; programming responds to culturally specific needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Equity, Impact, and Belonging — deepen inclusive engagement
rubrics_metrics.description: Encompasses initiatives across all programs to deepen engagement with storytellers and audiences across ethnicities, genders, abilities, sexual orientations, and geographic regions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program-wide focus on equity, representation, impact, and belonging in selection, support, and audience engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Producers Program — year‑round continuum of support for producers
rubrics_metrics.description: Supports both fiction and nonfiction producers at all stages of their feature-length projects and their careers through a year-round continuum of support.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Offers multi-stage career and project support tailored to producers' needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Women at Sundance — support and gender equity for women filmmakers
rubrics_metrics.description: Dedicated to providing support to women filmmakers while creating gender equity in American media and innovating ways for women to succeed as storytellers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focuses on removing barriers and creating pathways for women in filmmaking and storytelling careers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sundance Collab community — mentorship, feedback, and connections
rubrics_metrics.description: Sundance Collab is a free-to-join global learning and storytelling community for creators offering advice, personalized feedback, resources, and opportunities to forge new connections with other artists.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Platform is for learning, sharing, connecting, and accessing peer and mentor feedback; membership is free-to-join.

rubrics_metrics.name: Code of Conduct — harassment-free and respectful program environments
rubrics_metrics.description: All Sundance Institute programs are environments where bold, creative, and distinctive voices are celebrated; Sundance is committed to allowing attendees to experience these programs free of harassment, discrimination, sexism, and threatening or disrespectful behavior.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Expectation of respectful conduct from all participants across labs, intensives, and sessions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Code of Conduct — enforcement and consequences
rubrics_metrics.description: Sundance reserves the right, without notice or refund of any related costs, to limit or revoke access to our programs for those who engage in such conduct.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enforcement may include limiting or revoking access immediately and without refund.

rubrics_metrics.name: Code of Conduct — reporting violations
rubrics_metrics.description: If you are involved in or witness something that violates this code of conduct, please notify someone on our staff.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sundance staff will work swiftly and discreetly to take appropriate action upon reports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Emergency procedure
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Participants should contact local emergency services in urgent situations in addition to reporting to Sundance staff as appropriate.
